JE LEVEL 5 STUDENT WORKBOOK



What you get in this pack
    40 lesson pages: one organiser per lesson, in the Teacher Pack order.
    10 story openers: nine story cycles and a tenth story for the capstone pairing.
    Thinking Tools, Thinking Passport, Word Fossil Log and certificate.
The separate six-chapter JE storybook workbooks supply the stories. Use all ten with their chapter
numbers. No third-party novel or online account is needed.
These pages organise your reasoning. Use extra paper for paragraphs and the full 400–600 word essay.
A blank box is space for your work, not a completed answer.
A practice scenario is fictional. A factual comparison needs a teacher-supplied verified source; record
missing evidence honestly.

Your Thinking Tools
My name: _______________________ Date: __________

 Move                                   Question

 Claim                                  What bounded position can I defend after a fair concession?

 Evidence                               Which exact short words? Name story and chapter.

 Interpretation                         How does the language operate?

 Cultural Warrant                       Why does this affect voice, access, labour or authority?

 Ecological Warrant                     What specific material, water, land or habitat process follows?

 Impact                                 Which case, evidence status, treatment, owner and limit?


Counter-Argument Protocol: strongest opposing reason → precise concession → evidence-based
reply.
Accountable Talk: mark an idea; press for a clue; extend a reason; concede; defend. A written turn
counts.
Mechanism verbs: attributes, suppresses, qualifies, contrasts, reframes. Explain the mechanism
rather than decorate a sentence.
Truth status: exact story quote / labelled classroom transformation / fictional practice / verified factual
source. Missing evidence stays missing.
